title: Hanasato Minori — Card Story

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Why are you closing your eyes?
You didn't sleep well last night?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, that's not it.
I'm trying to do a menial rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-menial rehearsal...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What's a menial rehearsal?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Minori is aspiring to become an idol and often practices on the rooftop after school. I'm sure she does so at home too, so maybe that's what she meant by menial?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ah, sorry. Don't mind me. I was just wondering, what exactly do you do for a menial rehearsal?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well... I've been watching a DVD of this particular idol recently. The singing and dancing is so cute!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So a menial rehearsal is where I think about what it would look like if I'm the one singing and dancing instead.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... So you don't actually sing and dance while you're doing that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No. I would be annoying the neighbors if I did that, so I just try to imagine it in my head!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Imagine? Are you referring to mental rehearsal, actually? Instead of menial...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Eep! You're right!
That's it! Mental rehearsal!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe... I mixed those words up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, it happens.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's amazing, though, doing mental rehearsals even at school. You're really hard-working.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Not true! For anyone aspiring to be an idol, this is the very least we can do to get better!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Being able to do it like it's just an ordinary thing is what makes you so amazing to me, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Don't say that! It's not that big of a deal at all, really!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In terms of commitment, I'd say...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Look! Shiho's hands are moving while she's listening to music, right? She must be tapping out the bass notes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ahh, I see!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And that's amazing, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What do you want?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe, sorry for interrupting. I was just wondering if you're also doing some form of mental rehearsal right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hm... Well, I guess you could say that.
When listening to band songs, I try to think about how I would play it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Or how the bassist I respect would play it.
I try to picture a few things in my mind.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ah, I knew it!
I do that too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You can learn so much from those who are good at singing and dancing. I tend to watch their videos again and again!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then I try to imagine what I would look like dancing the same moves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: When I'm actually dancing, I also think about what the expert dancers would do at this or that part!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I understand. This is something everyone aiming to get better has to go through.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Ah... Well, you're always so cool and composed.
I was just surprised to hear you to talk to us so cheerfully.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, I was surprised too!
That was probably the first time I've seen you smile!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey... I do smile.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! Of course you do!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, lunch break is over.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Aww, that's a shame.
I was hoping we could chat a little longer.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane, Shiho, let's have another chat again soon!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Once in a while's fine, I guess.
Pet House

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, bun-buns!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This is our first time on duty. I hope I can do this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll be fine! Let's give them the best care we can!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: First of all, we should gather the bunnies into one corner so that we can clean the hutch without interference!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay. Let's see... Quietly from behind...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! P-Please stop wriggling!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh no... It ran away.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Most bunnies don't like to be held.
But don't worry! Look at this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, bunnies!
Come over here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: By getting the bunnies to climb onto your lap like this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And up!
Okay, wait in this room for a little while, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? You picked it up so easily!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The main thing is to make them to feel comfortable around us, so that they're not afraid of us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait for them to approach you instead, and then lift them up and support the butt like this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's amazing! Okay, I can do this too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The bunnies in the hutch should be very used to being handled. You'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Just wait patiently, and they'll come.
Then lift them up gently by tucking your hand underneath, and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I did it! I picked one up!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Well done, Kohane!
Okay, that was the last bunny.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Sh-She already transferred most of the bunnies into the room while I was struggling with just one?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now we have to sweep the hutch.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
O-Okay. You're so good with this, Minori.
Were you also in the caretaker committee during middle school?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was! I've been in the caretaker committee since elementary school because I love caring for animals!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She's cleaning up the area so quickly as we're talking!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have a dog at home too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? What kind of dog?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A large breed of dog called a Samoyed.
The name is Samo!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Samo's such a cute name.
Here, the dustpan.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks! What about you, Kohane?
Do you keep any pets at home?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
My father keeps a snake at home.
She's all white, so we call her Count Pearl.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You have a snake?!
Wait, wait, what does it feel like to pet a snake?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And we're done with the cleanup!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That was fast...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It's like...
When you're doing this, you seem a lot more... Well...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha, I'm a lot faster and more efficient than usual?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? No, I...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it!
Lots of people said the same thing about me in middle school, too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm super confident in animal caretaking!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, the sooner we finish cleaning the hutch...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Finish cleaning the hutch...and? Ahh!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe, it's nuzzling you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-That tickles...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
The others are coming closer too.
Let's feed them now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Here... Wow, they're eating the food so quickly!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's so cute when they're munching away like that... My soul has been healed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Aww, you're so fluffy...and so cute...
This is my favorite part. Feeding them while petting them like this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... Just now, when you spoke about finishing the clean up sooner, you meant...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! Finishing sooner gives us more time to pet them!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, I thought so.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're so fluffy...
I can't wait for my turn to care for you again!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi and Shizuku are late.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Maybe their lesson ran over time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was going to wait until everyone was here, but I guess I can show you first.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've been thinking about what we'll need for our debut! Do you mind taking a look at the list I wrote?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not at all, show me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(You rarely see Minori looking so earnest.
This must be very important to her.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks! So...
Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
What's this...?
A list of...catchphrases?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! You've got to have your signature catchphrases worked out, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I...suppose so?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That's not what I was expecting, but that's the sort of thing Minori would come up with...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wrote catchphrases for everyone in our group. I'll start with mine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ahem!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Just an audition regular no more!
This yet-to-debut idol will move mountains to graduate into a full-fledged celeb!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Just an audition regular no more!
This yet-to-debut idol—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No need to repeat, I heard you fine the first time...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This catchphrase conveys your personality very well but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's just it won't work after you've debuted, see? Wouldn't it be better to come up with something you can keep using, make it your thing?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh... Yes, you're absolutly right!
Why didn't I think of that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll see if I can come up with something that can stick for longer!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, let's move on to the catchphrase I wrote for you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The resplendent Haruka is the brightest star in this universe!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What do you think? Do you like it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see where you were going with it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But resplendent and brightest star, that's a bit too much, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, maybe, yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But maybe adding even more shiny imagery to it would make it more memorable!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The dazzling, resplendent Haruka is the shiniest, brightest star illuminating this universe! Twinkle-twinkle!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That... That is memorable, but it doesn't say much about me, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... It takes more than to say you're our brilliant star to express your appeal, huh.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright then! I'll have a think about a better catchphrase for you, which will convey all your amazing qualities!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Just make sure it doesn't get too long.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And what did you come up with for Airi?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Airi's is this. Energy blast!
The silly-cute, mega expressive idol, cool on the outside, mellow on the inside!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Er... That's very spot on, but you realize she'd get mad if she heard that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? But I really worked hard on this one, and I'd like to show it to her!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How about... Before you reveal this one to her, ask her what she'd like to put in her catchphrase, okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
She might already have one, you never know.
You wouldn't want to push your ideas onto her, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Gosh, no, of course not!
It's incredible how you think of everything, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... But then I might also need to rethink Shizuku's.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What did you write for her?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shrouded in an air of mystery, here comes the ultimate ditzy lady totally obsessed with her younger sister!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's an apt description of Shizuku, but I don't think it's flattering for an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I can see that now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But you know, it may depend on the situation! I've got lots of alternatives, too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Can I take a look?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure! For example, I have this one for you too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... Personally, I like it, but Airi would say it doesn't have idol vibes.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh... Then what about this one?
It has a nice rhythm to it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What's this... Five syllables, followed by seven and five again? That's a haiku poem...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Genius, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You know, you inspired me to try to come up with some catchphrases of my own.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?! I did?! That's great!
Let's write some more together!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's start again from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure! Um... Yikes, the wind's so strong!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh, yeah. It makes it difficult to hear anything.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This wind is nothing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When you're performing on an outdoor stage, sometimes you have to keep singing in a torrential rainstorm, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Gosh, really?
In that case we'd better toughen up by practicing in this weather!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Something just got blown over?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A flyer for a gig or some other show?
Minori, it's coming at you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? Yikes, got to dodge that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Blarg!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The wind changed direction and the flyer flew right back.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, you really have the worst of luck.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Get it off me!
I can't see anything!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't flail your arms and I'll take it off you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Phew... That wasn't pleasant.
Thanks for helping me, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: With things flying around, someone could get hurt. Why don't we take a break until the wind dies down a bit?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We don't have any shows scheduled, so there's no need to push ourselves so hard to practice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Speaking of shows!
There's something I wanted to ask you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How do you deal with anxiety before a show or some other big event?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I even get stressed out before auditions.
If you have any tips, that'll be great.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You get stressed easily, Minori?
I'd have never guessed.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? Minori always goes full steam ahead, so I could tell she wasn't the type to relax before shows.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Minori's the type to get so worked up, it makes her panic and get all clumsy, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What, you read me like an open book! This is why I was always doomed at sports events in elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Airi
rows.Line: (I knew it...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It makes me even more stressed to think that I might get so nervous that I'll make a mistake even after lots of rehearsals...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like to help but... I don't think I've ever experienced stage fright.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What, seriously?! W-Wow!
So you never worry that you might slip up and embarrass yourself?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The only thing we have control over is how much we practice, so if I feel I've practiced enough, I leave it at that and I don't worry about what might happen.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, that's not going to be of any help to Minori!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, listen. You must not be afraid of failure!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyone can make a mistake, no matter how much they've practiced. And when that happens...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You just act unfazed and say something along, Huh? That wasn't right? I don't know what you're talking
about.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's an option?! I... I don't think I could do this. I'd be so self-conscious, I wouldn't be able to just gloss over a mistake.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've got to strengthen your psyche!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's easier said than done.
I think she's better off following my approach and practicing lots.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... Shizuku, and what do you do to stay calm?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hmm... I try not to think about having an audience until the show starts.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's hard not to get a little anxious when you know there are so many pairs of eyes on you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see... That method I can try right away!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, but, in your case, you might benefit more from paying close attention to the audience.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wouldn't it motivate you more to see all those people you want to entertain, to hear them cheering you on?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, that's some good advice! I can picture Minori getting really motivated by seeing our expectant audience!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. Out of all of us, Minori has the most idol potential.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? M-Me?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, the wind seems to have died down.
Would you like to get back to practice?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure. We've had a long break.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's pick up from where we stopped.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wait! Can someone first explain to me what you meant about me having the most idol potential? Hey!
Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Tomorrow's the day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The day we perform on stage to cheer Haruka up with that beautiful sea of blue!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's an important day, so I should sleep early.
Okay, let me turn off the lights now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Urgh! I'm wide awake because I'm feeling so nervous... I won't be able to fall asleep like this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Unlike Momoi and Hinomori, I've never performed on a stage before.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What if I make a mistake and end up disappointing Haruka instead?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-Stop thinking like this!
You promised Momoi and Hinomori you'd try your very best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't waver at this crucial moment...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? My smartphone just...
Isn't that the light from—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Good evening, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Miku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Are you looking for me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I thought you seemed a little nervous at today's rehearsal.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I was worried about that, so I decided to drop by. Sorry for disturbing you at this late hour.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's no problem at all! I'm really happy to see you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you for coming, Miku.
You're right. I'm so worried that I haven't been able to fall asleep.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even though Momoi and Hinomori are supporting the plan, and you and Rin are helping out, too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I feel bad about becoming so nervous just before the show...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It's normal for people to feel nervous before trying out something new. In fact, the more you practice, the more you become afraid of making a mistake.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But don't forget that you're not alone, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Airi and Shizuku will be performing with you tomorrow. And don't forget that Rin and I will be there, too.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Everyone will be there to support you!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yup. You have friends around you who are ready to put in their best effort together with you.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So you'll be fine! If it ever seems like you're about to make a mistake, we'll be right there to back you up!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Have confidence when you're on the stage, Minori! Let's bring the brightest hope to Haruka together!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hope to Haruka...together...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes...you're right.
On the stage, I'm not alone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was so nervous I completely forgot about that important fact. Thank you for reminding me, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe, you're smiling like your usual self again.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm glad you're feeling more relaxed now.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll work hard tomorrow like I always do, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I just need to remember my practice sessions with Momoi and Hinomori and everything will be just fine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll make sure Haruka receives all the hope that she's given me so far!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, let's put all our strength into tomorrow's show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Go, go, go!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Go!>
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two, three, four, turn...and pose!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I did it!
What do you think, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You've gotten a lot better!
Now all that's left is for you to bear in mind how to make the costume look cuter.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? Costume?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. A proper idol must know how to use their stage costumes to their advantage!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Plan the costume's movements into the dance routine as well and make them look as cute as yourself!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I get it now! You're so good at this, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Admittedly, it's hard to imagine that in our workout gear. We'll have to look for an idol-style costume somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Idol-style costume, huh. Well, we've only just recently decided to form an idol group together, after all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We don't have any official costumes, yet... Ah.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We do have a cute, idol-style costume we can use, Airi!
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank goodness we can still come back!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Miku and Rin really helped us a lot, giving us advice about Haruka and singing the song that was born from our feelings together with us...)

rows.Line: Minori, Airi!

rows.Line: Hi, there! Anything we can help you with today?

rows.Line: Yeah! We were just practicing our dance routine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we were hoping to improve it by being conscious of the way our costumes moved around during the dance too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So we were wondering if we could use the clothes with the clover motif that we wore when performing here before?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A dance routine that makes your costume look cute... Sounds like something we could learn from, too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We should join in the fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd love that.
May we join you, Minori and Airi?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course you may! Please give us some good pointers, too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, let's change and practice now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You got it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Urgh... I can't move anymore...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're such a mess.
You should learn from Miku and Rin.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good work, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That was really fun!
I'm glad we could practice together!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Our performances would be more appealing if we could make our costumes look cuter on stage too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it's so difficult to do...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's easy to think about making the skirt sway in a cute way, but to actually do it is too hard for me right now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's not something you can do right away for sure. Even I still find myself wanting to do better at times.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The more important thing is to actually start thinking about it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Simply doing it for the sake of doing it is meaningless.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Think of the feelings you have towards the song and all of your fans. Without those feelings, you'd just be trying to look cool, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What's truly important is the feelings I put into it, huh? That's the same for interview self-introductions too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, in your case, you have no lack of strong feelings, so all you need to do is work on your expressions by practicing like just now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I'll try my best to learn all sorts of expressions!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Rin! It's almost time for our show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're right! Come on, let's put what we just practiced into use♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. See you later, Minori and Airi.
You're always welcome here♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess we should head back soon too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Do you think I could practice for just a little longer?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, I thought you said you can't move anymore?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm fine now!
I want to be able to have better control over what you just taught me today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's good! Then let's practice until you're satisfied!
Lunch break

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, it's time to begin our trial video shoot!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem excited.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I am because we're finally doing idol stuff as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! So let's start already!

rows.Line: Oh, thank goodness. You fixed it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Did something happen to that tablet?

rows.Speaker: Minori

rows.Line:
Okay, let's try filming something!
Ready, start!

rows.Speaker: Minori

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's recording, so you can move now.
And if you could say something...

rows.Line: Oh, I'm so sorry... I'm just not sure what I should be doing for the video is all...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:

I just have to take a video of you, right?

rows.Line: There should be a red circle towards the bottom. Just tap it lightly and all you need to do after that is hold the camera up!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Red circle... Oh, this one!
Tap it lightly...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah, Shizuku! I think your finger's covering the lens. Could you move your right hand down a little bit?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see, move my right hand down...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! You need to take your hand off the screen too...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? The screen changed into something else...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha, it registered that as a swipe...

rows.Line: Shizuku, if you move your fingers while they're still on the screen, it'll react to them, so you need to take your hand off first...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh dear... It keeps making these clicking sounds too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yikes! The camera app switched to burst mode!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Umm... I just have to remove my right hand. There.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Phew... It should be fine now.... Wait, what?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, there are so many different screens... What is this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shizuku, your left hand!
Your fingers are pressing a bunch of stuff!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, then... I'll just hold it with my right hand...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eep! Wait, Shizuku! If you hold it like that, it'll happen all over again!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is what happened...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehehe. I see...
That must've been quite an ordeal...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hahaha, s-sorry for laughing, Minori, but that's what happens when you let Shizuku use anything electronic...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, it's not very nice to laugh!
We were both in a total panic then!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But imagining the both of you scrambling around like that... It's a shame none of it ended up on video.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're so right! I wish I could see the faces you were both making then!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew... It's been a while since I laughed so hard.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. We've been feeling lost and confused lately, laughing really cleared my mind. All thanks to you two!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? Then laugh all you want, I guess...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now, shall we go back to our video shoot?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Practice felt really productive today!

rows.Line: Alright! I just have to keep trying then...!
Hello...

rows.Line: Yes! How may I...?

rows.Line:
Whaaa?! Haruka...?!
Everyone?! What're you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You didn't seem like yourself just now, so we came to see if everything was okay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: D-Does that mean... You saw everything...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. We saw you walking around like you were desperately looking for something...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you still feeling self-conscious about that whole idol aura thing...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Err...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You dummy. I told you not to worry about it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't quote me on this, but I don't think this aura you're thinking of is something you consciously give off.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. It could just be that your ability to shine has just reached its infancy too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, in your case, it may take you a little longer than usual to reach the final stage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even if that's the case, we'll look for it together, Minori. A way for you to truly shine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka... Everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're right...
You're absolutely right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If you really think so, then stop trying to get scouted like this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're more likely to get ripped off by some sketchy salesman selling expensive school supplies before a talent scout finds you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That's not true!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Besides, I fully intend on becoming an idol with MORE MORE JUMP!, regardless of whether or not I get scouted!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right, so let's work on that together.

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wanna grab a bite at a cafe before heading back?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's go!

rows.Line:

Let's have... Oh, I guess she's not here yet.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If it means getting to have lunch with you, Haruka, I can wait as long as it takes!

rows.Line:

Let's eat, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... Did you have any problems coming to school this morning?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was worried that you might've drawn some extra attention on your way here because of our first livestream yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I appreciate the concern, but I didn't have any trouble. I wore a disguise.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A disguise?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. It's common knowledge that Airi, Shizuku and I attend this school.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's why I wear my regular clothes on the way here and change into my uniform afterwards. I was wearing a hat and sunglasses, so I don't think anyone recognized me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! I should've known!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, it can't be easy. Having to wear a disguise means you always have to carry a change of clothes with you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's not so bad. I wouldn't mind if it was just me, but I can't very well cause trouble for the school.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I only really wear a disguise when I'm alone as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. If I'm with my friends, for example, something simple is usually enough. I'm guessing people find it harder to talk to me when I'm with others.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I think I understand. I'd feel bad about disrupting your personal time since talking to you then would be kind of rude.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Looks like I was right.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's thanks to the fans' consideration that I'm able to avoid inconveniencing my friends. It's also really nice being able to get a breather and just shop once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have to think Airi and Shizuku feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! If you wear a disguise to school, that probably means they're doing the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi for sure. From what I understand, she almost always wears a disguise out in public.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I don't think Shizuku does much more than changing how she dresses and putting on a pair of glasses.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Shizuku's someone you'd just recognize with a quick glance.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But she has this aura that might make it hard to approach her even if you do realize who she is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess that's true.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll have to start making sure I don't cause trouble for those around me as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: On the other hand, nobody even knows who I am yet, so it's probably way too early for me to even worry...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't think that's true at all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's great you're already thinking about how to protect the smiles of those around you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! N-No, it's nothing as great as that. I just thought it'd be rude to inconvenience others by simply doing the things I like!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm wondering if I can pull off a disguise too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I feel like I'll end up picking a look that ends up making me stick out even more!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I can imagine you walking around looking all worried that you'll be made.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I knew it! Maybe I should start practicing now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Let me know when you want to try and I'll give you some pointers.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! That would be great!

rows.Line: The first step is getting enough recognition so that a disguise becomes necessary!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's do our best, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Line: That means I'll need to start working even harder than I have been. Or rather, I want to work harder.

rows.Line: I see!

rows.Line: (I'm so glad Shizuku's feeling better!)

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Line: Airi told me that you said you like me just the way I am.

rows.Line: The Shizuku from Cheerful * Days had a mysterious quality about her, but was so great at singing and dancing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She felt like someone who was so far out of anyone's reach and it was always so wonderful seeing her like that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But... I think I like Shizuku as she is now more.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Yes. After hearing that, I decided I need to try even harder for you and all the other fans who feel the same way about me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really do appreciate it. So thank you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I hope we can continue doing our best together.

rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: You can push a little harder than that.

rows.Line: Hnng...

rows.Line: Oh, was that too much?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No. Go ahead and push a little harder.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, harder?!

rows.Line: You know how I get tripped up and stumble a lot, right? I need to make sure I do plenty of stretching to avoid getting hurt.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that makes sense! Okay, I'll push a little harder then!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Line: (I didn't realize Shizuku was putting in such an extra effort for the fans like this.)

rows.Line: (But her fans, myself included, always just saw her as the perfect idol.)

rows.Line:

rows.Line: (But it's different now! I'm seeing just how much work she puts in every day!)

rows.Line: Phew... Okay, shall we switch?

rows.Line: Right! Don't hold back, Shizuku! Push as hard as you can!

rows.Line: Got it. Let me know if it hurts, though.

rows.Line: (And now, the fans will get to see just how hard she works for them!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It's probably gonna surprise a lot of people...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I think seeing her working so hard without ever giving up will help give everyone the courage to keep going as well!)

rows.Line: Huh?! Oh, I... That's...!
