rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Haruka was watching me practice that whole time just now too...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She seemed genuinely worried about me when we went home together that one day too.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wait! Does this mean I'm making her worry about me again?!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (No, I have to tell her that everything is alright now...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (B-But what if I'm wrong...?! That would also be really embarrassing...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe... Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You were making some funny expressions just now, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was wondering what was on your mind too. One moment you looked surprised, but turned red a second later. Just one expression after another.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-what?! I just let it show?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, you did. So what were you thinking about?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I, umm... I was worried that you asked me to take a break because you were concerned about me again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I just suggested that because I thought it was a good idea to stay hydrated...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel like you're all better now, Minori. Especially after you asked me to believe in you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You've really been amazing lately.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Until now, you seemed to always be questioning yourself or not quite know what to do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that's changed. Now, you seem much more confident about yourself.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's probably because I met a fan of mine...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A fan?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! This person claiming to be my fan came up to me and even promised to watch our show...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: For now, they may be the only one out there trying to support me right now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But for their sake, I want our show to go well!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But can I make one correction to that? Aside from that person, you have three other fans, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! You mean...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. Airi, Shizuku and myself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Your determination and the way you never give up are what helped us get back on our feet.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So you... We'll be just fine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Everything that was bothering me, like not practicing too much or that uneasiness I felt... It's all gone now...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(All it took was just one smiling face...
And Haruka... Haruka's so...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, nothing!
Please, ignore that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehehe...! I'm so happy!
I have four fans already!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One made me want to work even harder.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Four means I need to...
More and more and more and more...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehehe. That more and more might just turn into a pretty big number.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's make sure that happens by having our show become a big success!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Humhumhumm♪
Yesterday's show went so well♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I shouldn't let it get to my head. I need to keep working hard starting with this morning's practice and... Hm?

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: Whoa, is that...?!

rows.Speaker: High School Student B
rows.Line: *Gasp*! Is it really her...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm not sure, but it feels like everyone is staring at me for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (*Gasp*! Does my hair look funny?! Did I fix my bed head?! Are my clothes on backwards...?!)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Um, excuse me...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eep! Y-Y-Yes...?!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Y-You're Minori, right...?!
From MORE MORE JUMP!?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Y-Yes...!
I am but...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
No way...!
I'm a huge fan of yours!
C-Can I shake your hand?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-O-Of course!

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: Look! It really is her!

rows.Speaker: High School Student B
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! No, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Assembled Onlookers
rows.Line:
Minori, please shake hands with me!
Can I get your autograph?!
Let's take a picture!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
W-W-Waahhh!
E-Everybody, please settle down...!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Huh? This is... The school's rooftop?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh, right. We're having our morning practice but I came too early, waited for everyone and nodded off...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Minori, is everything okay?
You seemed surprised for a second.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Were you having a bad dream?

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Voice
rows.Line: My shoulder probably didn't make the best pillow for her. Maybe my lap would've been better...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, no. It wasn't bad or anything. I think I was just so happy that I felt like screaming and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Where's Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's right next to you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She is...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wah! Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No! Now I remember...!
You said that you'd wake me up when everyone came and I just went straight to sleep...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She told us everything too. Apparently, you were so happy that our show went as well as it did that you couldn't get to sleep last night.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, shouldn't it be the opposite? Normally, you'd be so relieved that you'd have no choice but to fall asleep.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hm? Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You look much better now than you did before, but you do still seem a little tired.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I do...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The three of us were talking and thought that maybe we should skip our morning and lunch practices, and do something light in the evening.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. It was our first show in some time as well, so it may be good for all of us to get a little rest.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But no sleeping during classes, okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Of course!
I also feel much better after Haruka gave me some time to relax too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, by the way...
What's this dream that made you so happy and want to scream like that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Teehee. Well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You had a dream about being surrounded by your fans...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They all came stampeding towards me and I didn't know what to do!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, I still only have one fan, so there was no way that could be true...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh? Are you sure about that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. She may be right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I believe that everyone who watched our show yesterday saw just how wonderful you are, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. The day you suddenly get mobbed by your fans might not be so far off.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha. Thanks, but I'm still not sure what I should do then...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't worry. If necessary, we can teach you what we know about how to interact with them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. As long as you know what to do, you won't have to panic.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! In my dream, I couldn't even get myself to tell everyone thank you for supporting me like that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And... If I do meet them again, I have to tell my first fan how much they mean to me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So everyone, please!
Show me the way!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So... Minori, Kohane...
Friends?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yup, friends!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. This is great!
We became much, much closer just like that!
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, we're all here.
Let's start our little run!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You seem awfully happy, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Were you looking forward to this that much?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! We usually run by ourselves since we all run at different speeds.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There's also somewhere I'd like to stop by while we're doing this!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Where?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Somewhere with really pretty cherry blossoms in full bloom!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I went to see them with some of my classmates the other day and want you to see them too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Cherry blossoms... That sounds nice...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It does. I haven't had a chance this year to go see any either...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me neither. Let's make it the last stop for our run.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay!
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, over here!
The cherry blossoms are still...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Nooo!! What happened?!
There were so many more last time...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's been pretty breezy lately, so they might've gotten blown away...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But...
I should've shown you guys sooner then...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our streams have been keeping us busy, so I'm not really sure we could've...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But they were so beautiful. I really wanted everyone to see them... Oh, wait...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They really are beautiful, even though they're a little past their peak.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
It really feels like spring now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. Thank you for bringing us here today, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. They're still enjoying everything!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How about we do our cooldown here? You know, while we look at all the cherry blossoms!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it's been a while since I last just stopped to see some cherry blossoms like this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right... You were all too busy when you were still idols...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, we did get to see them sometimes as part of special segments and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel like we're going through a really important time in our lives right now, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not just seeing the cherry blossoms like this. Even the things we've been doing together, at school, everything...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's almost weird that we're going to school like this because of how busy we used to be.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We even got to participate in the Sports Festival and choir recital.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. We've even had time to make new friends, go out together and just have fun...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Important might not be the best way to describe it, but it feels like we should be cherishing these moments.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. It's almost as if we may be having too much fun for our own good.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't think so!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: All of you worked so hard until now to give people hope! You absolutely deserve to have a little time to enjoy yourselves!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, not a little... A lot!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, if you put it that way, Minori, we might be asking a lot more of you in the future.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course! I'll do whatever I can!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
In that case...
Mind going off to buy some Japanese sweets for us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, right now?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, some rice cakes too.
Those spring-themed ones if you can...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's be nice. Also, some sweet soybean powder ones would be good too, and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
W-W-Wait!
I don't mind running off to get them, but I don't have my wallet on me right now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sorry, Minori.
We were just joking.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No store that carries this stuff is gonna be open this early, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... You really had me going there for a second...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. But the four of us having a little Japanese sweets party together might be nice, especially if the weather stays this nice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure. We can do that at school on the rooftop or in the courtyard!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That'd be great if we really could do a little party like that!)
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Great practice today.
I'll see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Bye, Minori, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Bye, Shizuku. Alright, Minori, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I've sort of been looking forward to walking home with you, Airi♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we don't really live near each other and usually just go our separate ways after school...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly, but I'm heading your way today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right, the Japanese confectionary shop you like so much. I haven't been there in a while either. I'm feeling a rice cake craving coming.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you wanted one when we went to see the cherry blossoms too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I really like them, you know? Oh, we're here...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Since we're here, maybe I'll get something too. Hm...? Airi, there's something posted on the window...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're right. Let's see... Today and tomorrow only! Special discounts on rice cakes and other sweets...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi, does this mean...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes, Minori!
It's time for that!
The next day - Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting.
So there's something you need to tell me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Do you remember what we talked about when went to see those cherry blossoms the other day?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When we went to see the cherry blossoms? Something about this being an important time in our lives and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know! A Japanese sweets party! Airi was looking forward to having one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ding! Ding! Ding! We have a winner!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And your reward will be...
An assortment of Japanese sweets!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wow...!
So many kinds of rice cakes...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, she wasn't kidding!
Where did you get these, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. The confectionary shop we went by yesterday was having a sale...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We decided to ask the shop to deliver us some freshly made sweets for this occasion.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. I've actually been looking forward to doing this as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
Just for today, we can take a break and eat whatever we like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay...!
I have tea too, so bon appetite!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, enough talk.
Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mmm... These rice cakes are so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They are. The bean paste is so well made too. I might need to be careful with these...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, right? It's so easy to get carried away with these...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're grinning, Minori.
Are you having that much fun?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I was just thinking that it's so nice that we've been getting to spend more time with each other.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, this is where we all first met too, isn't it?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're right. I met you when you were in the middle of dance practice...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then you two ran into Shizuku and me when we were arguing about something...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. Then we met Miku...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The first time we went to SEKAI, everyone looked so down even though we got to see such an amazing show...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's not true that you have nothing more to give.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It was a little tough when I couldn't express how I really felt...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But we were able to come together and form MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. It still feels like a dream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it does. It took us a while, but everything started happening so fast too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sure we'll have some long days ahead of us, but it'll all just fly by us in the end.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. That's why we need to spend each and every day meaningfully.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly! We just gotta keep doing what we need to do, keep making video and we'll have a million followers before we know it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A million...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You heard me! We gotta aim high, right?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! You're right, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're a member of MORE MORE JUMP! too, Minori, so you'll have to keep doing your best too, okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I will...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She's right. I have a fan now too. Someone that's out there supporting me!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm still only at one, but I want to be able to deliver hope to more and more people!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna do my best!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, huh...? Cherry blossom petals...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They could be from the tree in the courtyard.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But they're pretty, so I say it's a good thing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's as if they're cheering us on as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You might be right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright! Let's all keep doing everything we can! More and more and more!!
After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haruka, let's go up to practice...
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry, be right there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, see you tomorrow!
Good luck, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah! Thanks, Saki!
Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sorry about interrupting your conversation with Saki just now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
I was just talking with her about what we did yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: About yesterday?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, about how we went to that karaoke place...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: L-O-V-E! Let's go! HA-RU-KA!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey! Hey! LOVE & PEACE!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Encore! Encore!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Um, Minori... It's your turn to sing next...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
I probably got a little too excited there...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it was fun having you cheer like that for me. It almost felt like an actual show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. We also spoke about the Penguin Cafe. Tenma was actually the one who originally suggested it to me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, she was?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She was, and I wanted to thank her for it because we had so much fun there.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That place had so many cute penguins and goods... It was too adorable...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. It felt therapeutic too. It was so hard to decide what to buy too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know, right? I'd like to get them all, but that's not really possible. At the same time, choosing just one felt just as impossible...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's so true. I couldn't decide and I ended up getting more than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, you did!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You had such a cute look on your face when you were deciding what to get. Just like a little girl in a candy store.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh, nothing! I didn't say anything...! Hahaha...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (There's no way she didn't hear that... What do I do...?!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Um, Haruka...
Sorry for letting that just slip out like that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You really know how to just be yourself, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? I do...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think so. Minori the idol really doesn't seem all that different from the Minori I've gotten to know...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Like you don't have to put on a face for anyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess so. I try to be energetic when I'm on camera, but that's sort of just who I am...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: See? I knew it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I'd like to ask you this if you don't mind. What do you do when you want to relax or feel refreshed?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Refreshed...?
I'll play with Samo!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh? Samo as in your big, white Samoyed?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah! He's so big, white and fluffy!
His slightly droopy eyes are really cute too♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's also really cute when Samo rolls around on the floor! He just whisks all my worries away...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. Having a pet like that does sound nice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right. You don't have any at home, do you?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, we don't...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've had chances to interact with animals through TV shows, but I don't think I really have outside of that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Y-You're kidding!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Y-Yes?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please! Please come over to my house and play with Samo as much as you like!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, hold on... Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure! Come to my house after school...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, wait! I have to clean my room first! I didn't put away the books and DVDs I was looking at yesterday...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I really want you to feel Samo's powers first hand!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I appreciate the offer, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'd feel bad just barging into your house on such short notice. Still, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Today might not work, but why don't you come over during our next day off and walk Samo with me?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Walk Samo?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We can meet at a park nearby, walk him and feel his fluffiness together! Would that work for you?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I might need to see just how great Samo is if you keep insisting like this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course! You're always welcome!
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I get to walk Samo with Haruka today. It's gonna be so much fun...!

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: *Whimper*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Are you excited to see Haruka too, Samo?

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I am too. I really want her to feel just how fluffy you are.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I usually brush you after our walks, but just for today, I did it beforehand...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And you smell really nice since you just took a bath too. You couldn't be in better shape for today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We need to make sure Haruka has a good time, okay, Samo?

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, I'm finally here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka!
Thanks for coming today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now, let me get you introduced. This is my dog, Samo!

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Nice to meet you, Samo.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: He's pretty big when you see him in person like this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's because his fur's extra fluffy. Whenever he takes a bath, it goes completely flat and he'll shrink to about half this size.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's cute.

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: *Whimper*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... I think he wants you to pet him, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me... Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've never petted a dog this big before... What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh... How about you start by squatting down and gently brushing your hand over his face and onto his forehead?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: L-Like this...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it gives him a chance to sniff you a little and feel more comfortable.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... He really is sniffing me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now, try petting him while working your way down to his neck.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wow...
He's so fluffy...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: He... He's like a ball of cotton candy...!

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: *Whimper*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think he wants you to keep going. Look, he's really wagging his tail!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, he is.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You can try calling him by his name too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Um...
Do you like it, Samo?

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, he replied.
He's moving his ears around too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. Isn't he the cutest?
Oh, he also likes being scratched under his jaw and on the side of his face♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Under his jaw... Oh, you're right...!
He looks so happy...!

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: *Whimper*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Haruka looks like she's having fun. How can you not with this much fluff?)
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks for letting me play with Samo today, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, I should be thanking you!
Thanks for giving Samo so much attention today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: He seemed to really like being with someone outside of my family for a change.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. Samo really loves getting petted and having this kind of attention...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But he's so big, you know?
Younger children are a little scared of him because of that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But you gave him just what he needed, Haruka! He looks so happy!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right, Samo?

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then I'm glad. It wouldn't be fair if I ended up having all the fun.

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: *Whimper*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? What's wrong, Samo?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, Samo, no!
Don't chew on Haruka's skirt!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sorry, Haruka...!
I don't think he's ready to say goodbye yet...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I understand.
Thanks, Samo.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But it'll be dark soon.
We can play again some other time.

rows.Speaker: Samo
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. He's such a good dog.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm glad Haruka got to have so much fun today.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I know she really loves penguins, but could it be that she just loves all animals?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (In that case...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, there's actually someone I go on walks with pretty often!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Like a friend?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm pretty sure you already know her too. Honami from 1-B!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Hoshino and Tenma's old friend...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, she has a Shiba Inu called Shibao! He's not as fluffy as Samo, but he has a really nice coat of fur!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I really want you to meet him too, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Ah, I see.
I'd like to meet him if I can.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Great! I'll make sure you do someday!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, Haruka and I are gonna start working out all the details for the graduation event.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sound good! In the meantime, Shizuku and I will try to come up with lots and lots of quiz questions.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We may also want to give them some extra space to work.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So I guess we're gonna have to ask the teachers to take over behind the camera for our stream...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right.
How should we handle their angles and positions?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll be moving around quite a bit, so it'd be strange to have them all locked into place.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's true too...
What if we did something like this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Those two are so amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It's like they know exactly how to make an event as fun as it can be and where we need to be careful.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I hope that I'll be able to hold discussions like that with everyone someday...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (No, I shouldn't hope! I have to believe that I will!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And I have to make sure I do as well as I can right now to make that happen!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, shall we start working on the quiz section?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem very excited about this, Minori. I promise to try my best too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's begin with... Oh, Minori, have you had a chance to look through the reference materials we have about the elementary school we'll be visiting or its website?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm all set!
We're supposed to base the true or false quiz on that, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. In that case, why don't we start coming up with some questions?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hmm... This is harder than I thought it would be...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (These questions need to be easy enough so that elementary school students can answer, but we can't make them too easy either...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'll try checking the school's website again. Now, where did I put my phone...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, this must be...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hey, Minori, Shizuku.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: MEIKO! Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Sorry for the sudden interruption. We were wondering how things were going in terms of preparing for that event.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You came at just the right time. We happen to be working on that right now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi and Haruka are working on how we'll actually be streaming this event along with scheduling and such...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And we're in the middle of coming up with quiz questions.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, you said you're doing a true or false quiz with everyone... And it's all about the school, right?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What do you think about having Miku and MEIKO look through our quiz questions, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've come up with a few already, but don't really feel all that great about them...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's a wonderful idea!
Would you two be okay with that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Sure, sounds fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Okay, here's my first question...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Any thoughts...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<I thought it was very fun!
My favorite was the one about the school being founded 500 years ago.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I liked the question about the school trip and how it's designed to have the older students know the answer.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You did?! Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, but...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Was there something that caught your attention?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Well, it's nothing that major...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's totally okay!
I want to hear all of your suggestions!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This might be the only significant contribution I'll be able to make for this event!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <In that case... About the question that says the school was founded 500 years ago...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The little ones may know what the number 500 is, but may not be able to comprehend just how long 500 years is...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I see... The fifth and sixth-graders may be the only ones that can imagine what this area was like 500 years ago based on historical dating...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Right. I don't think it's necessarily bad in terms of a true or false quiz, but...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (500 years ago would've been the Azuchi-Momoyama era, right? That means...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know! What if we rewrote it to say that the school was made when there were lots and lots of samurai still around?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, that sounds much better!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I agree. This should help give the little ones a better idea of what the question's asking!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think so too! Great idea, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, you should be thanking Miku for making such great suggestions.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think the rest of our questions should also be written like this. What do you think, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree completely!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I'll help you two out as best I can♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Me too!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm gonna do everything I can to make this as fun as it can be!)
Gym

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Looks like our stream's wrapped up.
Great work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, everything went so well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Finally, we're done. Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, the stream might be over, but you're still an idol!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's not like the students have gone anywhere, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no! Y-You're right!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Haha! Minori's in trouble!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wait, they were on my team during tag. I wonder why they're staring at me like that?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(They seem a little shy...
A-Alright, I'll try talking to them!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... Hi...

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: M-Minori...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for playing tag with me just now!
I had a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They smiled...! Thank goodness...!)

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Um... Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes...?!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Can I get your autograph?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-My autograph?!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
She's doing autographs?
I want one too!

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Hey, no fair! We want autographs too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! P-P-P-Please! Everyone, calm down...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Right on cue...
Look who's the kid magnet now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Do you have a pen, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I do but...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-My autograph's still a work in progress, so it might look a little funny...!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
You don't have your own autograph?
What kind of idol are you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Wince*

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: D-Don't tease Minori.

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line: Yeah! If you don't have one, we can think of one together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's a wonderful idea.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, it totally is!
Mind if we join in on the fun?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wait, Shizuku?! Airi?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'd like to help as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You too, Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Why don't we all grab some pens and notebooks for our brainstorming session?

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How did this happen?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Minori, some look like they've finished already.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's so cute. Please, take a look.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line: Minori, here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you. Oh, it says, Minori, and it's covered in flowers! That's so adorable!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Minori, I'm done too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really? Thank you!
Oh, you've written out my full name! Thank you for remembering! I don't know what to say!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hehe!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've got another one over here.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Um... Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, did you think of one for me too?
Mind if I take a look?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Uh... Here...
I tried to make the M in Minori look like a clover...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're right! It looks just like a clover now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I love it! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They're all putting in so much effort for this... I'm speechless...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hmm... I'd like to give back too, somehow... What can I do for them...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (What if, for example, Haruka came up with a sign for me and I do that autograph for her in return...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That's it!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, everybody...! Would it be okay if I tried using all of the autographs you just came up with?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Really? Even mine?!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Mine too?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd like to give each of you a one-of-a-kind autograph as thanks for doing all this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Would that be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
One-of-a-kind?!
That'd be awesome!

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line: I want one too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's a great idea, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, but you'll need some time to practice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right!
I need to learn how to write all these...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! I'm gonna try my best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Let's see, I do this and...
There! I think?

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line: Lemme see! Lemme see!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's have a look...
Does the flower to the bottom-right look okay to you?

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line: Maybe if it were a little more nice and round...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You got it! Nice and round...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All of the sudden, Minori's become a bit hit with all the students.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She really has. I'm so glad for her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I also wish that we were still streaming. It would've been so nice to show everybody what we're seeing now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. It would've been a great opportunity to show just how wonderful a person Minori really is.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's a little unfortunate...
However...

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line:
Teacher, look...!
Minori wrote the autograph I came up with just for me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I doubt these students will ever forget what Minori did for them today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shouldn't you start a little higher, Minori? It might look a little funny in the end if you don't.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
Thanks, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And... Done!
Here you go!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Minori!
I'll treasure this forever!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're very welcome!
Diner

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here's to a great practice!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Kohane & Nene
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd like to thank you again, Kohane, for letting us join your team for practice today!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Getting to practice like this with everyone was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
About that, Kohane.
Are your practices always like that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Like how...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You know, how everyone seems a little nervous or on edge...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Was it a little too tense for you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, nothing like that. It's just, everyone was taking everything so seriously.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, you guys are all just able to say what's on your mind right then and there!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I noticed that too... You guys don't really hold back or try to coddle each other.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's almost like it's hard to get mad when you're told something that bluntly.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I thought that's really important!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree. Being able to say what needs to be said or being willing to hear what you may not want to is no small feat.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly! By doing that, you'll immediately get to know and even trust each other!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not only that, you guys are so detail-oriented.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha... Yeah, I kept getting warnings about not staying in rhythm or maintaining my pitch...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be fair, that was on a level where regular people probably wouldn't have been able to tell if they heard you sing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Still, Aoyagi has such good ears.
Does he have a deep music background?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, he does.
He used to do classical piano and violin.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Does that mean Shiraishi and Shinonome can play instruments too...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, not as far as I know...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But An's liked music since she was little because her dad used to be a professional musician.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We even formed our group in order to surpass this legendary event that he helped organize.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Shinonome actually got into street music because of that event too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But he doesn't have much of a music background, so he had to learn everything on his own and practice so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: All of that on his own...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I heard that your team's full of incredible people, but I didn't know just how incredible until we practiced together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And you were brave enough to jump in with them! It's just so incredible!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Every other word you said just now was “incredible”, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In that sense, you're just as incredible, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree. You're working alongside three idols who used to be really popular in MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: One of them being the Haruka Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm? Well what?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Kiritani's the idol you've been looking up to since you were little, right, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So she's like your hero...?
It may take a while until you catch up to her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's the thing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's not just Haruka.
Airi and Shizuku have been teaching me so much, but I still have such a long ways to go.

rows.Line: G-Good work...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You did really well today, Minori♪
Your energy during the chorus was great!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... The lyrics feel really “cheerful and energetic”, so I did my best to make that as obvious as possible.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
That explains why I liked your happy footwork so much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yay...
B-But I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, no sitting before getting in a proper cooldown. Just hang in there a little bit longer...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Once that's done, you'll be rewarded with drinks. We've prepared some cool lemonade for you today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Reward drinks...!
I'm ready for our cooldown!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Geez, you're so easy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Since practice is going so well right now, you should be able to smoothly transition into your new song after you master this dance routine.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, you're getting the demo for that pretty soon, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I can't wait to hear what it's like!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me neither. Based on the melody we heard before, I have a feeling it's going to be a wonderful song.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The way she worded the lyrics was nice too. In that sense, it really felt like it was written just for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah. That was just part of it too.
Imagine what the complete package is gonna be like!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I'm so glad we asked her to do this for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She probably had to work up a lot of courage to contact us, so I'm super grateful that she sent us that email!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's really nice. I'm looking forward to hearing it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, this is so amazing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's amazing?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How our thoughts and feelings have become a part of our outfits and songs!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We have all these feelings, but you can't really see them or easily describe them to others, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But our outfits and songs send everyone a clear message because they've been inspired by our feelings! Isn't that incredible?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You have a point. Seeing the outfits Shizuku designed for the first time was pretty amazing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, she's right! Having a design on paper was great, but seeing our outfits in real life was something else!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It really felt like they could cast this wonderful spell on us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Shizuku, it's your feelings and the feelings of those who made them in physical form!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The song and dance routine we were just practicing feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The song's lyrics are meant to cheer people up, so it's just as important to make sure it's choreographed in a way that encourages everyone too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Especially since you've been putting so much effort into improving your footwork, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm still not there yet, but I'm doing my best to exaggerate each step and make myself visible.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. That's no different from the idols you're all trying to be, right, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? No different?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Aren't you all striving to be idols who “give them hope for a better tomorrow”?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The thought that your outfits and songs have been imbued with your feelings is indeed beautiful, but you're just as incredible as individuals.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You really think so...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm with him!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, your fans had smiles on their faces after seeing all of you perform in person, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That means we were able to cast a spell on them too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A spell that gives them hope for a better tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
A spell of hope...
That does sound wonderful.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That means you girls, as spellcasters of hope, are going to be singing a song written by someone who feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-You're right!
Doesn't that make us super strong?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! Now I really can't wait to hear that demo!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! I'm gonna keep practicing my singing and dancing to make sure I get my feelings across!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's the spirit, Minori! You can do it♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you... Even though practice left you totally exhausted a second ago...

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.
Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, that concludes today's meeting!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We actually get to sing it now!
I'll be waiting once I get my voice all warmed up!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good idea. I think I'll join you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Seems a bit early to warm up, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A bit?! It's way too early!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Hehe.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<Oh, before I forget.
Would you mind doing a little favor for me?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure, what would you like us to do?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <As I work on this song and put the final touches on it, my goal will be to give it more of an MMJ feel...>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <If possible, I'd like to know if there are any words, phrases or other things you'd like me to include in this song.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <By incorporating what you value most, my hope is that it'll turn into something that really hits home with not just you, but your fans as well.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something that really hits home with us and our fans...?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Yes. What do you think?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That's...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's so beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's gonna be a song that brings us all together! That's so beautiful! Like movingly beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll tell you whatever you like!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Of course, we'll also be more than happy to tell you all about MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Thank you very much...!>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <I won't be using what you say word for word per se, but I'd like to learn more about what you feel is most important to you as they come to mind!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, clovers for one!
They're even a part of our outfits!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Your outfits?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Oh no! I forgot...!
I'm not supposed to talk about our SEKAI outfits! I need to divert her away from that somehow...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, so...!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Oh, that's right. There were some on the outfits Hinomori designed. I remember thinking that they make for a really adorable motif.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Y-Y-Y-Yeah, those!
They're super cute, right?! Hahaha...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By the way, Hasegawa, do you happen to know what three-leaf clovers symbolize?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As for me... Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's more like what I want to value moving forward as opposed to what I value now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, like what?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How there's more to being an idol than just standing on stage.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Airi...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even if you get laughed at, even when you can't be on stage anymore... Idols can still spread and inspire hope in others.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I kinda like the phrase, “I'm going to win against yesterday's me!”

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Oh wow! That's so you, Momoi!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it really is!
This is why Airi's such a cool person!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why are you the one getting giddy, Shizuku? Also, how about you go next?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, me?
I like the phrase, “It's important for idols to have heart.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yeah! Airi told you that when you were both still in training, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! I had to stay to keep working on my dancing and Airi decided to lend me a hand...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Thank you all very much. My heart won't stop pounding after getting to hear such precious stories!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Woohoo! I'm glad you had so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hold up. That wasn't the point of this conversation.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That just leaves you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Haruka, what words or things do you see as being most important to you?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You may be asking the right question, but someone else really should be doing the asking...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. What's most important to me is to, of course, keep spreading hope to everyone...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But these words left the biggest impression on me during my career as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh! I wanna hear!
What kind of words?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “Haruka, you gave me my dream of becoming an idol!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “I want you to see this view! To remember what it's like to look forward! I want you to believe again that tomorrow will be a better day!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hang on, that's...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's what you told me, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! You remembered?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. You're the one who “gave me hope for a better tomorrow”.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<Thank you so much!
What I learned today has given me a much better understanding of all of you.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Glad to be of service.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. Feel free to ask anytime if you have any questions.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Especially since there are some things that we can't really talk about on our streams.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Uh oh... Looks like one of us still hasn't come back down to Earth yet.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
She seems so happy.
Why don't we let her enjoy her moment of bliss a bit longer?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay.
SpoJoy Park

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh noooo!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Minori? What's the matter?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Look! Over there!
That claw machine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I thought so! It's usually six tries for 500 yen, but you get eight tries if you go now!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! Why didn't the machine we used just earlier give us this kind of deal?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I've got a good feeling about this one...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you want to give it another try, Hanasato?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, I want another go at PenPyon!
Would that be alright?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I say why not?
I'm still a bit salty over our last attempt.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure, we can make a stop before we head out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you!!
Alright, we're definitely getting it this time!
Arcade

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Careful... Careful...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, that looks like a good spot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, we should be able to make it stand up and roll over...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, it's pushing PenPyon up a bit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Now it just needs to roll over and...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, it's stuck standing!
It's not moving like we expected!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How are you doing, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh wow!
She got the claw around the entire plushie!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Good! This should...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Why wasn't it able to get a hold of it?! There's totally something wrong with this machine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I guess you're having trouble too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Trouble? No, this machine's the problem! If that's how it's gonna play...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Your phone...?
What do you plan on doing, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: One of my brother's friends is really good at winning stuff from claw machines, so I'm gonna ask about what we should do through him!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll send a pic over of your machine too, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, for now, once more!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna try my best too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we'll be here cheering you on.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No... I still can't get it!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're both so close too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, I got reply from my brother...!
There's a part about your machine too, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Let's see... In your case, Minori...
You're supposed to grab it by the hat on its head and gradually move it towards the prize chute.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Its hat?! Yeah, it's true that PenPyon's wearing a little top hat...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What if you're supposed to do that because the hat's sturdier than the plushie itself? That way even if the arm is weak, you could still get it to move.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, now I see!
I'm gonna give it a try, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, I think I've got a good idea too, so I'm gonna get back to it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry, Ichika, but can you stand next to the machine to spot how my claw's lining up?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm not sure if I'll be of any help, but...
Would you like me to do the same...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, here goes nothing!
Aim for the hat... First, my horizontal position...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Next, Kanade, my vertical position!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'll tell you when to stop.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Just a little bit more...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
H-How does it look...?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it seems good.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, now we just need to get the claw to hook onto the top hat...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
...!
It got the hat...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's up...!
Even though it wouldn't budge at all when we tried to get it to roll over...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That was amazing! It's a lot closer to the chute now! Two more tries tops and I think we've got it!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. Let's keep this up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, you seem pretty happy today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. Check out this picture...!
Especially you, Haruka!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What picture?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wait... Th-That's...!
PenPyon?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! We got it from a claw machine at SpoJoy Park!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: SpoJoy Park...? The sports facility by the station? Hang on. Did you go there just to get this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Remember how I went out to exercise with Kanade? The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? So, you went to SpoJoy Park with Hoshino and a couple others.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We went to the arcade and got in some exercise by rollerblading, playing bubble sumo and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still, I'm surprised.
I didn't think Ena would be interested in exercising since she prefers to stay at home most of the time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. Wait, didn't she mention something about swelling in her feet or ankles when we messaged her the other day?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, she did say that!
That might be why she thought that she needed to exercise.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I think so.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kanade also said that she wanted to increase her stamina so that she can keep composing music...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Increase her stamina to compose music?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And we can do something less strenuous and more fun this time! Maybe something simple, like the trampoline!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Fun...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry, but I'd like to do something a bit more challenging...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? But...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I appreciate the concern you're showing for me, but since I'm here, I want to increase my stamina as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because if I don't, I would've skipped working on music for nothing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Kanade had such a serious look on her face that time.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I guess it's a testament to just how much composing music means to her...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But it was nice to see her having so much fun when we played strike zone together.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?! I'm sorry...!
What you said reminded me of something.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If it's alright with you, Haruka, I'd like you to have this PenPyon!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What? I'm speechless... But you worked really hard to get it, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, very!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We thought we could get it initially by rolling it to the chute, but that didn't go so well!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, Ena asked her brother's friend who's good at winning stuff from claw machines for some advice!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We took their advice and I had Kanade help me with the timing and stuff... And voila! We got it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, we worked really hard to get it, but it's also why I want it to go to someone who'll take good care of it. So, what do you say?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: After working so hard to get it, I couldn't be happier to hear that you believe I'll take good care of it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But... I can't accept your PenPyon.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whaaat?!
Wh-Why not?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You just said so yourself just now, right? How winning it was a collective effort.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because you all worked together to get that PenPyon, I think it should stay with you as a reminder of how much fun you all had at SpoJoy Park.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I also have to think that PenPyon would like the same since you worked so hard to get it, no?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka...!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But if it's alright with you, Minori, I'd like to see it the next time I visit your house.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, of course...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's so nice of you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not only did you think about how Minori would feel, you also took PenPyon's feelings into consideration.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah.
Beach

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's move on to our next activity!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (What do we get to do next...?! I'm sure it's gonna be something our viewers will really enjoy like the banana boat activity we just did...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For our next challenge, we'll be...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Smashing watermelons!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Woo...hoo...?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Uh, that seems kinda dull lol.>
<That sounds more like playing than training.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. This exercise is actually pretty tricky and involves three people working together as a team.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Three people working together?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right! I'll start by explaining the rules, so listen carefully!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One person will be blindfolded while trying to smash the watermelon as per normal.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Another person will be allowed to guide the smasher by tugging them along using their hands and such. However, they won't be allowed to speak!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Guiding the blindfolded person while not being allowed to speak sounds incredibly difficult...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. Not being able to see is already pretty scary, so it might be tough to move in the right direction unless you really trust your guide.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right... I get why teamwork is so important here now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Finally, the third person will act as the messenger who will be allowed to speak, but that's all they'll be able to do. They won't be allowed to guide the others by touching them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, because the guide isn't allowed to speak, the messenger will have to relay information to the smasher?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It sounds like they'll be receiving plenty of support. Won't that make things too easy?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, you'd think so.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But what if the watermelon's placed 500 meters away?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! 500 meters?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: With a time limit of...three minutes!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's not a lot of time...
And being on the beach makes it just that much harder to cover such a distance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Did you really think that I was gonna make this challenge easy to clear?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry for doubting you...>
<I love Airi's smug face.>
<This is impossible, right?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I'll also have you rotate roles, so you'll each get a chance to try all of them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, let's draw straws to decide who's gonna be doing what for our first round!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, our first smasher's gonna be... Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
