rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because you're making such a weird face. Anyway, which do you want?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! Shiho, you're gonna feed me?!
Oh no...! Won't Shizuku get mad at me?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What does she have to do with this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But if you're gonna make it hard for us... Let's go, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, Shiho, wait!
I want to have some cookies!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. You get three cookies, Minori.
Which would you like?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd like... Oh, the one on the very right with chocolate on it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This one? Okay, here you go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aaahhh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You don't have to open that wide...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You're like a hungry wolf.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yeah! If only opening my mouth meant cookies would magically fly into it. Rawr...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What was that? That wasn't very wolflike, so take two.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Try to imagine being really hungry...
You've got to look like you're famished or no cookie.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Shiho, that's mean!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy
Outside the AV Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whaaat?! Kohane was here?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whaaat?!
That wolf was actually Kohane?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, it was! So...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, okay. She was just looking for her friend after they got scared and ran off...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're sorry that we couldn't keep her longer.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, that's okay. I mean, you were in the middle of your play, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still... Where could Kohane and An have gone?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, what if you checked the neighboring classrooms?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
This may be just me, but...
If I were to become scared and run off somewhere, I'd probably find a nearby classroom to hide in.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that makes a lot of sense! Hmm... One of the neighboring classrooms...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And if I knew that someone there would help me, I'd be more inclined to seek them out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Someone who'd help...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's it!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wah! Minori?! What's wrong?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You made a light bulb go off in my head, Honami! Someone from a neighboring class who'd be willing to help!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I've gotta go!
Thanks again, you two!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Good luck, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And we'll let you know if we see them!
Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
Ugh... Why didn't I realize this sooner?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka's in Class 1-C, which is right there! She's known An forever, so this might be where she went!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see... Haruka should be...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I believe that's everything you have ordered.
Please enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There she is! Haruka...!!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An came just a second ago, but left right after.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, why?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Probably because that zombie wolf came chasing after her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have a feeling that she didn't know Kohane was the one dressed as it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no... We need to let her know as soon as possible that this is all just a big mistake... Wait a second...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, how did you know Kohane's the one who's dressed as the wolf?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Based on her voice.
I tried to ask her what was going on...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But our customers also became pretty startled. Some had their little children with them, so I had to...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hey, Wolfie!
I think you're in the wrong forest!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Shouldn't you be at Class 1-A?
Are you here to advertise your haunted house? It's called “Little Red Riding Hood and the Young Goats' Slightly Scary Forest Adventure”, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Y-Yes!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Class 1-A is doing a haunted house!
I-It's really fun, so we hope you'll stop by later!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That's amazing, Haruka!
You're so good at thinking on your feet!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I actually need to thank Kohane for picking up on what I was doing so quickly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, after that, she headed towards the AV Room to look for An...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She did...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait... I asked Aoyagi and Shinonome where they went and rushed towards the end of the corridor... What if I just missed them?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There are a lot of people here today, and a lot of signs and stuff lying around...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You'll probably have to keep a close eye out in order to find them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I've gotta find Kohane fast and get that mask off her head!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, can you wait here for a second?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you brought some orange juice!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm guessing you're pretty thirsty after running around so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're doing your best to help Kohane and An, so this one's on me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
“Meow. You can do it, Minori.
I believe in you♪ Meow♪”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Haru-meow...?!
(H-Haruka meowed?!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
M-M-M-Meow?! M-Meow?!
(Wh-Wh-Wh-What's going on?!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. We decided against talking like cats because some people in class felt too embarrassed by it, but I hope that made you feel a little better.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Better?! I thought my heart was going to burst out of my chest!!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, Haruka! In the name of your meow, I vow to find Kohane and An!
Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, it's almost time!
I'll start the group call... Now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Hello! Good evening!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Geez, you don't have to shout. We can hear you just fine.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <That just leaves Shizuku...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<Um... Am I connected?
Can you all hear me?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Yup, we can hear you!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Since we're all here, we can chat for a bit before the show starts.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Yeah! Oh, before I forget...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <I know my suggestion was really sudden, so thank you all for agreeing to watch iHaz with me.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<No worries.
I was actually pretty interested in watching.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Me too. And chatting while watching sounded like so much fun.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I agree. When you suggested that we watch it together, Minori, I was immediately for it. If anything, we should be the ones thanking you.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Whoa...!
I can't see your face, but I'm overwhelmed by your dazzling aura just after hearing you say that...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Oh, Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Also, aren't you getting a little too excited for your own good? You might end up crashing, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Oof... You're right. I'm usually so tired by the time this show airs that I prefer to record it instead...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <However, we're all here to watch it as it airs tonight, so I vow not to fall asleep!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Alright, we get it. Just don't push yourself too hard, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<Oh, Minori, that reminds me.
You watch this show often, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I know you already gave us an overview of it when we were at school, but do you think you could tell us a little more about it?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Yeah, of course!
So, I'm pretty sure that I mentioned how various idols from different groups lead the show each week.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Yes, you did. You also mentioned how seeing idols from different groups interacting with one another is one of this show's best features.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Exactly! A lot of them are meeting each other for the very first time, but they become really good friends sometimes after doing a segment together.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Interesting... That's kind of refreshing since groups don't usually get to meet and interact unless they belong to the same agency.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <I know, right? Not only that, it's sorta become normal lately for iHaz to trend on social media whenever it starts.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Which means just that many people are talking about it...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Yeah...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Also, because so many different idols appear on this show, it can become an opportunity for people to find new favorites.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Which is why I'm hoping that more people will decide to support us after seeing us on iHaz.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Yes, that'd be wonderful.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Speaking of which, Haruka, you already responded to that producer's email, right?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I did. They said they'll contact us again later since they still don't know who else is going to appear alongside us.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Okay, thanks.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Hehe. I can't wait to find out who that is...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Mhm...
*Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Minori...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Did you just yawn?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<I-I'm okay! I'm not sleepy at all! Sleep...
*Yawn*>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Oh, Minori... You don't have to force yourself to stay up if you don't think you can...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <B-But I wanna watch iHaz with all of you!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <And I'm sure I'll be wide awake after I see the opening since it's always so fun!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Alright, I guess we have no choice...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Haruka, can you wake Minori up by giving her a dose of your idol power?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Okay, I'll try.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh...?! H-H-H-Haruka?!
What are you doing in my room?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. What you're seeing right now is my idol aura. I'm actually still in my room.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When you've been an idol for as long as I have, you acquire these sorts of abilities.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, it worked!
I can do it too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too! Hehe. I'm glad we decided to give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You too, Airi, Shizuku?!
Wh-What about me...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm sure you can now, Minori.
Let's try practicing before iHaz starts.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let my idol aura build up inside of me... Build and... Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Minori, iHaz is about to start.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I think she fell asleep...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <She was going in and out when we were talking about who's going to be appearing with us.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <That's exactly why I warned her about crashing.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Luckily, she'll be able to watch it online later. For now, let's just enjoy the show...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Right. Especially since she seems to be having a fun dream.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... Mhm...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This seems like a good place to stop. Let's call practice here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, nice work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, there's something I need to ask before I forget. Would you all mind if we talked while we stretch?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, now that we've decided to accept that offer to appear on iHaz...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know I might be getting ahead of myself here...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I want you all to teach me how to look good on camera!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How to look good on camera?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... I have a habit of blinking or looking the wrong direction whenever I get pictures of me taken...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I wanna learn how to look better when a camera is pointed towards me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see. You're right that you're getting a little ahead of yourself, but I think we can give you a few tips.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You got it!
First, these shoots always involve a lot of cameras.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, it's important to check how you fit into each camera's frame.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How I fit into each frame?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For example, camera one might be pointed at you head-on, while camera two is looking at you from the side. You could be gone from camera three because it's looking at the people next to you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Where a camera is can greatly change how you appear in the end.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. There are cases where one camera's zoomed in on someone but they sort of waste their chance by looking and speaking in a completely different direction.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, it's not always easy to do those checks since everyone's usually scrambling around to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why you usually have to just imagine how you're gonna look based on where the cameras are located.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay, I see... That seems kinda tricky.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We have some time, so why don't we practice that a little?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? You can practice that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. We'll just be using the cameras on our phones, but it should give you a better idea.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, okay! Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be more than happy to help.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same. It's important to get used to this, so let's give it a go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, I'll be camera one, Shizuku will be camera two and Airi will be camera three.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll take turns raising our hands, so make sure to look towards the corresponding camera.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. This is fun. It's like a little game♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, kind of.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, your first challenge is to introduce yourself!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, your job will be to speak while looking towards the camera operator who has their hand raised.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi, Shizuku, are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup! Ready when you are!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then... Start!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (First up is Haruka's camera...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
I'm Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We mostly do live streams online where we get to meet and interact with our fans!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I see. Then, Hanasato, I'd like to ask you a question!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Of course!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Now it's Airi's camera...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Phew... I managed to give an okay answer...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hanasato, may I ask the next question?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Now it's Shizuku!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: May I ask the next question?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, of course...!
I forgot to respond!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh...
Hehe...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, geez. You looked way too serious while saying that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But!
It's so hard to juggle everything all at once...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I understand how you feel, Minori. It took me quite a long time to get used to it as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone goes through this, so let's just take it one step at a time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay.
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, this is it!
MORE MORE JUMP! is appearing on TV for the very first time. Let's get ourselves focused and ready!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem awfully excited, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's because I am.
My phone's also fully charged and ready to go.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, what does your phone have to do with this?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I need to do my best to convey just how amazing MORE MORE JUMP! is to everyone...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, since we've been given an opportunity to appear on TV alongside Cheerful * Days, I'd like to make the most of it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have to make up for what happened back then...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (For Shizuku's sake, I need to do well today...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Minori...?
Are you feeling a bit nervous?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
N-No, I'm fine!
Minori Hanasato's all set to make today's shoot a weally good one!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We get how you feel, but you're tensing up way too much...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's understandable. After all, it is her first time appearing on TV.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's good that you're eager to succeed, Minori, but the facial expression you're making is a little scary.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So, just try to relax. Then, smile.
Why don't we do it together?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That was a nice idea, Haruka.
Green Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! This is our green room...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I should take a picture of the sign out front that said, “Guest: MORE MORE JUMP!” later too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, all these yummy-looking snacks...!
A-Are these really for us...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, they are. This tea also seems to be for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! The green rooms at TV stations are way more amazing than I originally imagined!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori...
You were a nervous wreck just a second ago...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But I understand how she feels.
I was also a bit awestruck when I was given my first green room.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If this shoot goes well, we may be given more opportunities to appear on TV and enjoy these sorts of green rooms.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That's right. We might get the chance to appear on TV more and do other stuff as idols...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Just like Haruka when I was watching her...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sorry, Minori...
I know I'm putting a lot of pressure on you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, um...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I agree with you, Haruka.
I hope we get the chance to do more and more stuff as idols moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same. And I like your thinking.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Minori...
I'm gonna ask a huge favor of you right now. Would you mind listening?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Of course!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: First, curl your hands into little “C” shapes and put your thumbs together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Um... Like this?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, perfect!
Now stick your hands out in front of your chest!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
Wait a second... Isn't this...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ah, it looks like you've figured it out! Then, I'm guessing you know what to do next... One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line: Lovely! Fairy! Momoi.... Airi!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, Airi!
I got to do your self-intro together!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, that's when you're supposed to say, “Why'd you just make me do that?!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In any case, remember what Haruka said before we came here? How important it is to smile?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. Right.
Thanks, Airi.
And I'm sorry for making you worry, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. No problem.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, why don't we have some tea and snacks now?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: These chocolate cookies are particularly delicious, Minori. We always looked forward to having some whenever we were asked to appear on TV.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Are they really that good...?!
Then, I might just have to give them a try.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As for the tea... They've even provided us some honey. Shall I put some in your tea for you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, isn't that what you usually had when you were with ASRUN? Yes, I'd love to have some!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, it's almost time.
Everyone ready?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori...
You have some cookie crumbs on your cheek.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Staff's Voice
rows.Line:
MORE MORE JUMP!
You're on standby!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Understood!
Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I'm a little nervous...
But I feel a lot better now thanks to the others.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We've come this far, so I need to do my best during today's shoot...!)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, I believe we're all set for our next stream.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Why don't we call things here since it seems like a good place to stop?

rows.Speaker: Minori

rows.Line: Also, for Classical Japanese, I just need to memorize vocab and be able to explain what certain phrases and passages mean...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, now I see what you mean. Modern Japanese isn't as cut and dry.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Exactly!
That's why I wanna know how you guys study for it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well... For essays and stories, I try to see things from the writer or characters' perspectives.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: With novels in particular, I feel that it's important to dissect why a character's feelings change and in what way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
They always ask that on tests.
“Why did the protagonist feel the way they did?” or, “What led them to do what they did?” and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. Aside from that, memorizing the kanji and idioms being used might be good.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Lemme jot that down...
Thanks, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Next, Airi, please tell me how you study for this subject!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I really don't do anything that special.
Like Haruka said, I try to memorize the kanji, idioms, phrases and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, pronouns and stuff. You, they, him, her, this and that. Keeping an eye out for who's pointing to what is supposed to be good for reading comprehension.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...!
Then, Shizuku, how about you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Whenever I'm reading my textbook, I try to keep an eye out for conjunctions.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Conjunctions? Like “but” and “so” and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. While I like reading stories, I can't say that I'm very good with critical texts...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I feel that I understand them better when I actively keep an eye out for conjunctions.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, Shizuku, that sounds like a pretty high-level technique.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's not that hard actually.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For instance, when someone says, “I think this or that,” and follows it up with a “because”, that tells me they're about to explain their reasoning.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, if they were to use a “but”, that likely means they're about to say something to the contrary.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's amazing, Shizuku!
I'm gonna try doing that the next time one of those essays shows up in my textbook!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I have to agree.
The speed at which someone can digest text would change a ton depending on whether or not they did what you just said.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Did you come up with this technique by yourself, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, a teacher explained it to me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As a result, I'm having much less trouble reading and analyzing such texts.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Coming up with your own ways to make studying easier is really important, but so is asking the teachers for help.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After all, that's what they're there for.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna try everything we just discussed and ask the teachers any questions that I have.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That sounds like a good plan.
Studying all by yourself can be very difficult at times.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we've dealt with Minori's problem, let's start our morning practice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Minori & Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!
Campground

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, we did it...!
Our curry is finally complete!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Bring the camera in a little closer!
What do you think? It looks creamy and delicious, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no... I'm getting really hungry now!
Can we start digging in?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, why don't we begin?

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku, Airi & Haruka
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mmm! I love these big chunky veggies! It really feels like we're camping now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: On top of that, Minori, the curry you and Airi made has such a gentle flavor to it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The rice you two made is also really good.
How'd that go? It's pretty hard to cook rice using just camping gear.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Getting the measurements and timing right wasn't a problem, but controlling the heat was a bit tricky. The bottom became quite burnt as a result...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What are you talking about?! That crispy bottom's the best part! I think you're giving yourself far too little credit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. The texture's perfect, and I love it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm really glad you two like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We still have plenty, so please feel free to ask for more.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
I'm definitely having some more!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, I really wasn't expecting this curry to turn out so well when we first started the shoot...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me neither. We did draw from a hat to decide our pairs and what tools we'd be using, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting our tools to end up falling into two extremes like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Next, we have our fire-starting tools.
Airi, Minori, which of you is going to draw for your pair?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me! Minori Hanasato is poised and ready to draw!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm counting on you, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm...!
Please give me something good! Please give me something good...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This one! What do we get?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Lemme see!
We'll be using... Wait, what...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A strap drill...?
I've got a bad feeling about this...

rows.Speaker: Show Staff Member
rows.Line: Ah, the strap drill is right over here! Enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wait, this looks like...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I knew it!
We're back in the Stone Age!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry, Airi!
If only my luck weren't so terrible...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's okay, Minori. I have a plan.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I learned how to use one of these years ago on a survival program.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, you can count on me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-You're my hero...!
I promise to do everything I can to help get our fire started!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: For the sake of our curry!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's the spirit.
We can't let it end up as just a plate of rice!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't get it! Why won't it start?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But I'm seeing a lot of smoke...!
Wait, what if the wood isn't dry enough?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's possible.
At this rate, we're never gonna get our fire going...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi! Let me take over!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I drew the short straw...
And, I can't make you do all the work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't have as much experience with this as you do, but I'm not gonna give up! I promise to get our fire started no matter what!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, here goes nothing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Gnaaaaaaaaargh!!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Start! Start! Staaaaaaaaaart!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, that isn't gonna work.
The goal isn't to spin it as fast as possible.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You gotta use as much of the string as you can and get into a good rhythm.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay...!
Lemme try again with that in mind!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I still can't believe we managed to get that fire started and make this curry.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha... To be fair, I felt so exhausted after getting our fire started that Airi had to do all the cooking.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What are you saying?
I thought you were really cool when you did that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You didn't give up. You kept trying...
Not only that, you succeeded. I wouldn't have expected anything less from you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That means we're able to have this delicious curry together because of you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, Minori.
We're grateful for all the hard work you put in for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
N-No, I...!
I just felt that I couldn't give up is all...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, we're having this curry now because we all worked together to make it happen! I don't deserve all the credit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This is our curry.
It's MORE MORE CURRY!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
MORE MORE CURRY!, huh?
Hehe. Yeah, we did all work really hard on it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't put it into words, but it really tastes wonderful. I'd love it if we could go camping together again someday.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!
Ryusuiso - Peony Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We're going home today...
Time sure flew by...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It really did. The hot spring was really refreshing, the food was delicious... It's such a shame that we have to leave.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But there's still breakfast, so let's try to enjoy every second we have left here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, that reminds me...
It's actually almost time for breakfast. We need to move all the bedding and our stuff off to the side.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's do that...

rows.Speaker: Proprietress's Voice
rows.Line:
Good morning.
Would now be a good time for us to start serving you breakfast?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! Talk about perfect timing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Everything's cleared away...
Yes, please. That would be excellent.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Pardon the intrusion.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow! It already smells amazing!
What do you think they're serving?

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll bring each item to you one at a time, if you don't mind giving us a moment.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Salt-baked salmon! One of my favorites! Hehe. I'm so happy!

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Ah, Ms. Hanasato, I didn't realize that you were the salmon connoisseur I heard about.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Ayaka told me that one of you likes salmon very much and would really enjoy it if we served some.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: So, I decided to serve the largest salmon we had. I'll place it right here in front of you, Ms. Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thank you! I don't know what to say!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Saito remembered what my favorite food was...!)

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: There we are... Now, ladies, please take your time and enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Let's dig in!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm so happy for you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! This salmon's one thing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I think I'm even happier about Saito remembering my favorite food!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You are?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I've been noticing lately that our fans are starting to remember some of the things I've been saying on our streams. Like my favorite snacks and the cosmetics I use, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Some have been posting about it on social media. One person said, “I use the same cosmetics!” and another said, “I went out and bought some of those snacks you recommended, Minori.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Someone even wrote a letter to me saying how they're going to buy from the same brand as me the next time they go shopping.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Reading things like that really makes it feel like people are starting to know who I am.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I feel so happy knowing that I've grown as an idol!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I remember feeling the same thing when I was still in ASRUN. When I read things like that that fans had said, it made me realize how much they supported me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Of course, the fans who've been longtime supporters are all very important.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we need to do our best to keep showing the newcomers all new sides of us. Which means we gotta keep growing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She's right. I can't be happy with where I am currently...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The others all have more experience than me and have fans who've been supporting them for a really long time...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And they're still doing their best for them.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I have the least experience out of all of us, so I shouldn't be letting my guard down! That means I need to try even harder and harder and harder!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna power up by eating as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What are you talking about all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In any case, this is a perfect power breakfast. Salmon is packed with the protein that you need for strength training.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then I should also eat up and try to get the most out of this meal.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. But I'm gonna eat much more than you!
Odaiba Animal Land

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa! So this is the Carnivore Zone...?!
It totally looks like the wild!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, the atmosphere here feels really different from everywhere else.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm getting a little anxious... It's like we're being watched by all the animals.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, they have different routes for large and small animals. Which should we choose?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Based on the map, the one for smaller animals looks shorter.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You two have to go back to work, so why don't we go see the smaller animals?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right!
Then, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, this is apparently the section for the Tsushima leopard cats! What do you think they're like?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm also curious... But I'm not seeing them anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I'm pretty sure they're in here...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, how do you know?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because that bush over there just moved.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The bush...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, she's right!
They're walking towards—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, kittens! She's with her babies!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They're so cute...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that one's trying to get Mom's attention.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we gotta take a picture!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whoa! Where'd all these people come from...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And they're all taking pictures.
Do you think they were waiting for the kittens?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That means all these people are here to see them. They're like idols!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, they're going back into the bushes...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, already?!
I wanted to keep watching.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. All things considered, we were pretty fortunate.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we were super lucky to see them as soon as we came!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: As nice as it would be to stay, let's head over to the next section.

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Hey, did you hear?
The Pallas's cats are back!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Really? We gotta go see them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Pallas's cats...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What are they like?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm not sure, but I've definitely heard of them before.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They must be really cute if all these people are going over to see them! Wanna head over?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! This place is packed...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's way more people here now. I didn't realize they were so popular...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I can see why. I mean, look how cute they are.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You must really like them, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, this one just showed me its belly...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No fair! Show me your belly too, kitty!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Uh oh. It's hissing.
Is it trying to intimidate us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Us? Or just Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Whyyy?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe this just isn't your day for interacting with animals, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But!
I don't want the cats to be mad! I just wanna be friends with them!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Whoa! It just banged its paws against the window!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Wow, they're more ferocious than I thought. Is this one in hunting mode?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sounds like it's stalking you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Again, why only me?!
Odaiba Animal Land

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank goodness we were able to catch Dylan!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Can you tell us what we should do with him?

rows.Speaker: Zookeepers
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you so much!
We can take him from here!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Bye bye, Dylan!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There he goes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, thank goodness we were able to catch him without hurting him. Anyway, what should we do now? We still have a little time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, we could try checking out an area we still haven't—

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Excuse me. Are you by chance Haruka Kiritani?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! Are these people all your fans?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hello.
I'm here on my own time today, so I'd appreciate it if you didn't let word get out.

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: O-Of course... We're sorry about interrupting your visit! But... Umm... Would it still be alright if we asked for your autograph?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay.
It'll be our special way of commemorating us meeting today.

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you so much!!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Hey, that girl over there looks really familiar...

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Wait a second... Isn't that Haruka Kiritani?!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: And I could've sworn I've seen that girl next to her before too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is starting to get out of hand...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shouldn't we try to do something about this, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right...!
We can't allow this to cause the zoo any trouble. As a zookeeper for the day, I gotta do what I can...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: For now, Haruka, let's move somewhere with less people to keep things from getting any further out of hand!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What if we split up? We might stand out too much if we move as a group of four.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, we can rendezvous somewhere later.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, you two!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, let's go this way!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay.
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Excuse me. Would it be okay if we shook hands?!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Sorry, but are you Haruka Kiritani?
Can I have your autograph?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no. Your aura's too strong, Haruka. Everyone's noticing that it's you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm really sorry about this, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, don't mind me!
There's nothing we can do about your brilliant aura!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, the Rainforest Area's supposed to be pretty dark, so maybe less people will notice you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Really? That's great...!
You know this zoo so well. You're like a real zookeeper.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. But I'm still amazed by your powers, Haruka. All these people keep gravitating towards you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Not only that, you're interacting with each of them kindly like a great idol should! I still stand to learn so much from you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, wait...
Before I can do that, I need the kind of fans that would come up to me like that...!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Um... Excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes?! Would you like to shake hands with Haruka? Or would you like her autograph?

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: You're Minori from MORE MORE JUMP!, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
I'm a huge fan!
Mind if we shook hands? Also, can I have your autograph?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You're here for me?

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Would that be possible? The way you're always doing your best fills me with so much encouragement!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I'd be honored!
I'll be more than happy to do those things for you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm so happy for you, Minori.)
Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Phew, another exhausting day...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I had classes at school, then went to the TV station for our shoot, and after that we even had an interview for a magazine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Still, today's shoot went really well!)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Thank you for today, MORE MORE JUMP!
We're very grateful that you put in so much effort despite this just being for one segment on our show.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: I particularly enjoyed seeing the way your facial expression switched at the drop of a hat, Ms. Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You did?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's right, you were on a roll with your reactions today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The great thing about Minori is that those overreactions come out naturally for her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Seeing that always puts a smile on my face, so I almost end up watching the window with Minori's face instead of the video we're supposed to be reacting to.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehehe...
Wait, no, we need you to watch the video!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Hahaha! I'm sure they'll adjust things in editing to make you both look good.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone said I was responding well to that magazine interview afterwards too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Plus, the plan was to just have one page with some photos, but they said the interview got so lively that they might make their article longer or give us more than the one page!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If things keep going well for us, one of these days we might be asked to appear in our own section of a magazine, or on the cover.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-The cover...?! Us?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've got a couple of very special flowers in our garden, don't we?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Eep...!
S-So bright...!

rows.Speaker: Airi

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, because they've given me so much encouragement, I want to spread lots of hope.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It'd be so great if we could keep giving each other hope as I continue to work as an idol.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see...
That dream made you feel all these things?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm absolutely certain that you'll achieve your goal, Minori. You're going to become an idol who receives hope from her fans and gives hope back to them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The others and I will also give you all the support we can moving forward.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, if you ever need our assistance, please feel free to ask!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you, I will!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, in order to spread hope to lots of people, I'm gonna keep doing more and more!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, KAITO, please watch me perform that dance one more time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I feel like I can put on an even better performance now!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course! I'll keep helping until you feel completely satisfied, Minori!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's work together to produce the best performance we can!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, let me get to my position...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm ready, KAITO! Start the music!
